notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Happy new years everyone!

To help usher in this new year we have released version 1.3!
With it brings a slew of new things!



Patchnotes:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38698852/7233be4081e313795f2b985778ab11d158ae5f41.png[/img]
New Character: Genie
    She relies on her trusty genie to follow her around 
    and help block those pesky enemy bullets.

    Just keep in mind she is a slow defensive character 
    that plays best when you don't move around too quickly,
    so you can best utilize her genie.


The Opening Screen has undergone a complete 
transformation that just looks way better visually.


Various Character select screen visual bugs


The forest planet:
    Has been visually tweaked with a  few colors being 
    adjusted to help them mesh better.
    The forest planet also got an improved bush sprite


Various small bug fixes have been addressed.


KNOWN ISSUES: NONE
Once again we have released a perfect game with no bugs at all!!!




That's it for today, once again we hope you had a wonderful 2021 
and hope your 2022 is ripping awesome!

notes.title: Tlaxeu update is here!
notes.content:
The update is finally here bringing with it a new planet as well as a few cool new goodies, as always here is the patch notes!



PATCH NOTES:

NEW ADDITIONS:
new planet: Tlaxeu an Aztec doomsday inspired planet.
new weapon pick up:  Grenade Launcher fires a standard grenade at a minimum distance and 3 second timer, has 3 rounds.
Added a random hero selection which changes heroes each round.
added new main menu background.

QOL:
misc. changes to hitboxes for certain buildings and moving objects.
adjusted player walking animation.
adjusted groovy grove main menu background.
UI now no longer shakes when screenshake is enabled
mini grenade no longer insta explodes when attempting to pull pin
sound effect has been added when selecting character

KNOWN ISSUES:
Absolutely nothing my game is perfect in every way.



Thank you all for playing my game!

Frank Burnett.

notes.title: Demo update 1.0
notes.content:
Morning Heroes!

I have great news February 25th, is the final release date for the full game!!  
There's no better time to Wishlist then today! 

ALSO!!
The Demo has been updated to 1.0!
Here are the condensed patch notes.


--Game Improvements
- Added 5 new maps
- Added in end of round Awards (Try to find em all)
- Balance changes
- New tie room for ties
- More sound effects
- Bug fixing
- Fixed mask for objects that could be shot through
- Fixed areas that could lead to getting out of bounds


--ART
- Various character in game and character select improvements
- Improved shot gun pickup sprite 
- Updated Griefer art
- Added environmental rubble
- Impact Grenade no longer hurts eyeballs
- Added a new kill effect
- Removed strange orange hue that made
lighting look bizarre
- Added in more sprites for the cactus's? Cacti?


--QOL
- Updated select screen to dynamic music 
- UI improvements
- Removed some fog from graveyard to improve frame rate
---REMEMBER FOR ANCIENT PCS YOU CAN TURN OFF EFFECTS TO INCREASE FPS---
- End of round actually looks nice now
- Particle effect limits so your CPU doesn't get mad
- Updated Character Select Screen, Planet and Main menu
Now you can see more of what's in the full game.
- Massive fixes to performance, skull sprite now longer multiply endlessly
- All players are able to control everything in the menus minus map select


With this update its now much closer to how the full game will play minus balancing.

If you got any comments or suggestions slid into our DMS on Twitter
https://twitter.com/Twin_Stick_Hero

Thank you!

notes.title: Demo 0.6 Update
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

The Demo has been updated to 0.6!
Here is the patch notes for you book worms.

--Game Improvements
-Updated the 3rd Desert Background
-Increased visiblity for the Rage Item

--QOL 
-Allowed any player to control main menu  (This will allow any controller to continue past the main splash screen, many users have reported this to us sorry it took so long to fix)
-Improvements to the Character Select Screen
-Updated Logo
-Updated Splash Screen
-UI improvements
-Visual improvements
Version 0.6


As the main game is the focus for me at the moment and I'm the only programmer on the team the demo updates are gonna be a bit far and few between, up until the final game is released.


Also just wanted to say thank you all again for playing my game it means the world to me!
~Frank Burnett
